text:
lucas_prod: deploybot flagged embeddings drift in canary for matching route. Autorevert policy suggests rollback. want to discuss manual hold+pin instead?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary embeddings cosine drop > 0.06 (baseline 0.82 → 0.74). Autorevert in 90s unless overridden. See metrics: https://telemetry/redwood/embeds/1730007

anya_data: I see the drift correlates with a quantized tokenization change in PR #489. No HTTP errors; quality only. If we autorevert we lose the tokenization improvement but fix recall.

marc_sre: Oncall here. Is production impacted or only canary?

lucas_prod: only canary now but the deploy is phasing. If we let autorevert run it will revert prod too once policy detects trend. I'd rather do manual hold and pin route to stable for prod, then revert the PR on canary and rerun evals.

vera_pm: prioritization: customers using similarity search could see degraded results. We should notify CSMs if we touch prod.

marc_sre: OK to hold. I'll apply a short override so we can coordinate. Command: `deploybot override --thread 1730007777 --hold 600 --reason \"evaluate embed drift\"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by marc_sre for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

anya_data: Plan: 1) revert tokenizer change on canary (git revert PR 489) 2) run benchmark eval set (local/evals/embed-regress) 3) if metrics recover, promote; if not, pin prod route to previous model and open rollback PR. Commands: ```git revert --no-edit 489 && ./scripts/eval_embed.sh canary && rctrl pin-route --route /embed --model redwood-embed-v2```

lucas_prod: Good. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note for CSMs: \"We detected an embeddings quality regression in canary tied to a tokenizer change. We're holding auto-rollback to run a targeted revert and evaluation. No prod impact expected at this time\"

vera_pm: Make sure to include ETA and action items. ETA?

anya_data: ETA 25m for revert + eval. If results show <0.02 cosine delta vs baseline we will promote.

marc_sre: revert applied at 1730007810. Eval running. logs: ```eval: baseline 0.82; canary post-revert 0.815; delta 0.005 → within threshold```

lucas_prod: nice. Will we promote canary or pin prod first?

anya_data: since eval looks good, promote fixed build to canary and then let deploybot resume. We'll skip pinning prod.

marc_sre: `deploybot override --thread 1730007777 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by marc_sre. Normal autorevert behavior restored.

lucas_prod: promoted at 1730007875. I've posted the release-note snippet and linked PR in #release-notes. CSM ping sent.

vera_pm: thanks. let's track this in a follow-up ticket to add an eval gate for tokenizer/tokenization changes on embeddings routes.

anya_data: filing ticket now (ENG-embed-1219) and adding the eval harness to CI.

marc_sre: short and clean. closing thread."
